items.title: Kering Group Q2 2026: Revenues Up 1% as Gucci Improves
items.summary: Kering's H1 2026 results showed group revenue of EUR3.652bn in Q2, up 2% at constant exchange rates. Gucci's comparable sales fell only 2%, beating consensus forecasts of a roughly 4% decline, with leather goods returning to growth on the Borsetto and Paparazzo bag launches. CEO Luca de Meo said early signs of progress are emerging in brand desirability and commercial momentum.

items.title: Bernstein: Demna's Gucci Runway Debut 'More Good Than Bad'
items.summary: Bernstein analyst Luca Solca scored Demna's Fall 2026 Gucci runway debut 7.6/10, ahead of Sabato De Sarno's 6.8 debut. Feedback: jackets and trousers were fine, shoes and bags seen as uninteresting, and much of the rest read as vulgar rather than sexy, with the Roman-temple venue criticized as costly and unnecessary extravagance.

items.title: Gucci Seemingly on Cusp of Turnaround
items.summary: H1 2026 analysis: Gucci revenue reached EUR2.757bn, down 9% as reported and down 5% like-for-like -- still weak, but sequentially improving. Kering CEO Luca de Meo, in post since September 2025, continues executing the ReconKering plan under Gucci CEO Francesca Bellettini; piece cautions the turnaround, while directionally positive, remains a tough proposition.

items.title: PurseForum members split on Demna-era Gucci bags
items.summary: Forum discussion threads on Demna's Gucci handbags show a divided community: some members say the Jackie, Bamboo and Borsetto updates blend heritage and newness well, while others call recent collections underwhelming, with one self-described longtime 'Gucci girl' saying the output feels phoned-in and that interest in the brand has faded among peers.

items.title: Kate Moss Gucci runway G-string moment clip recirculates
items.summary: Short-form video of Kate Moss closing Demna's Gucci runway show in a backless dress with an exposed logo G-string continues to circulate on TikTok with strong engagement, captioned playfully referencing the piece's 1997 Tom Ford-era design lineage.

items.title: "Kate Moss Shines on the Gucci Runway" edit clip
items.summary: Edit-style TikTok video recapping Kate Moss's Gucci runway closing moment continues gathering views and comments weeks after the original show, part of ongoing fan-driven resurfacing of the Demna debut highlights.

items.title: Gucci official Instagram continues Borsetto/Giglio bag campaign push
items.summary: Gucci's official account (51M followers) continues to post Beauty and the Bag campaign content starring Kate Moss and Emily Ratajkowski, shot by Mert and Marcus, spotlighting the Borsetto and Giglio bags. This is brand-owned activation rather than independent public reaction, discounted accordingly per the sentiment rubric's activation-coverage rule.

items.title: Gucci: en passe d'amorcer son retournement?
items.summary: French trade coverage of Kering's Q2 results frames Gucci's slowing sales decline as a potential inflection point, while recalling that Gucci lost more than EUR4.5bn in revenue between 2022 and 2025, falling below EUR6bn last year, and noting the brand remains under scrutiny after 2025's EU antitrust resale-price-maintenance fine.
